test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A does half as much work as B in three-fourth of the time taken by B. If together they take 12 days to complete the work, how much time shall B take to do it alone?
solution: Given: A does half of the work done by B in 3/4th of time Time taken by A and B to complete the work = 12 days Calculation: Let the number of days taken by B to complete the work be x. Then the number of days taken by A to complete half of the work = 3x/4.
